name: Fausse Commune
summary:
Fausse Commune is a free game that generates fake names of French towns and villages, which resemble real names of towns and villages near a given location. Your goal is to guess which place it is by reading the generated names, by clicking on one of the blue dots on the map to give your answer!

"Fausse Commune" is a wordplay with "fosse commune" which is a potter's field.
